name: claude-nudge
description: Desktop and phone notifications when Claude Code finishes a turn or needs your input

ntfyTopic.title: ntfy topic
ntfyTopic.description: Your private ntfy topic for phone push. Pick a long, unguessable value; anyone who knows it can read your notifications. Leave empty to disable phone push.

minDurationSeconds.title: Minimum turn seconds
minDurationSeconds.description: Only notify at turn-end when the turn ran at least this long. Raise this if you get too many pings.

desktopEnabled.title: Desktop notifications
desktopEnabled.description: Show a local desktop notification on this machine.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Write a JSONL debug log to ~/.claude/nudge/debug.log (no secrets are logged).
